mapper.select: SELECT e.exam_id AS examId, e.title AS title, COALESCE(e.exam_type, 'MONTH') AS examType, COALESCE(SUM(eq.score), 100.0) AS totalScore, COALESCE(COUNT(eq.question_id), 0) AS totalQuestions FROM exams e LEFT JOIN exam_questions eq ON e.exam_id = eq.exam_id WHERE (e.template_exam_id IS NULL OR e.class_id IS NULL) GROUP BY e.exam_id, e.title, e.exam_type ORDER BY e.exam_id ASC

SELECT e.exam_id, e.class_id, c.name AS class_name, e.teacher_id, e.template_exam_id, e.title, e.exam_type, e.exam_mode, e.exam_round, e.status, e.exam_date, e.file_url, e.created_at, e.updated_at FROM exams e LEFT JOIN classes c ON c.class_id = e.class_id WHERE e.exam_id = #{examId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO exams ( class_id, teacher_id, template_exam_id, title, exam_type, exam_mode, exam_round, status, exam_date, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{classId}, #{teacherId}, #{templateExamId}, #{title}, #{examType}, 'PAPER', #{examRound}, 'ACTIVE', #{examDate}, NOW(), NOW() )

INSERT INTO exam_questions ( exam_id, section_id, question_number, question_text, question_type, large_category, small_category, question_type_tag, score, correct_answer, sort_order ) SELECT #{newExamId}, section_id, question_number, COALESCE(question_text, CONCAT(question_number, '번 문항')), question_type, large_category, small_category, COALESCE(question_type_tag, question_type, 'VOCAB'), score, correct_answer, sort_order FROM exam_questions WHERE exam_id = #{templateExamId} ORDER BY question_number ASC
mapper.select: SELECT e.exam_id AS examId, e.class_id AS classId, COALESCE(e.exam_round, 1) AS examRound, e.title AS title, COALESCE(c.name, '미배정') AS className, DATE_FORMAT(e.exam_date, '%Y-%m-%d') AS examDate, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM exam_questions eq WHERE eq.exam_id = e.exam_id) AS totalQuestions, (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT ea.student_id) FROM exam_attempts ea WHERE ea.exam_id = e.exam_id) AS gradedStudentCount FROM exams e LEFT JOIN classes c ON c.class_id = e.class_id ORDER BY e.exam_date DESC, e.exam_id DESC

SELECT e.exam_id AS examId, e.title AS title, COALESCE(e.exam_round, 1) AS examRound, e.class_id AS classId, COALESCE(c.name, '미배정') AS className, DATE_FORMAT(e.exam_date, '%Y-%m-%d') AS examDate FROM exams e LEFT JOIN classes c ON e.class_id = c.class_id WHERE e.exam_id = #{examId}
mapper.update: UPDATE exams SET class_id = #{classId}, title = #{title}, exam_type = #{examType}, exam_mode = #{examMode}, exam_round = #{examRound}, status = #{status}, exam_date = #{examDate}, file_url = #{fileUrl} WHERE exam_id = #{examId}
mapper.select: SELECT exam_id, class_id, teacher_id, template_exam_id, title, exam_type, exam_mode, exam_round, status, exam_date, file_url, created_at, updated_at FROM exams ORDER BY created_at DESC

SELECT eq.question_id AS questionId, eq.question_number AS questionNumber, COALESCE( NULLIF(eq.small_category, ''), NULLIF(eq.large_category, ''), NULLIF(eq.question_type_tag, ''), '기타' ) AS questionType, eq.score AS score, eq.correct_answer AS correctAnswer FROM exam_questions eq WHERE eq.exam_id = #{examId} ORDER BY eq.question_number ASC

SELECT exam_id, class_id, teacher_id, template_exam_id, title, exam_type, exam_mode, exam_round, status, exam_date, file_url, created_at, updated_at FROM exams WHERE teacher_id = #{teacherId} ORDER BY exam_id DESC

SELECT u.user_id AS studentId, u.name AS studentName, COALESCE(c.target_grade, '중2') AS schoolGrade, COALESCE(u.phone, '010-0000-0000') AS parentPhone FROM class_students cs JOIN users u ON cs.student_id = u.user_id JOIN classes c ON cs.class_id = c.class_id WHERE cs.class_id = #{classId} AND cs.status = 'ACTIVE' ORDER BY u.name ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO exam_attempts ( exam_id, student_id, attempt_no, attempt_type, entry_method, status, total_score, max_score, correct_count, total_question_count, primary_weak_tag, graded_at ) VALUES ( #{examId}, #{studentId}, 1, 'EXAM', 'MANUAL', 'GRADED', #{totalScore}, #{maxScore}, #{correctCount}, #{totalQuestionCount}, #{primaryWeakTag}, NOW() )
mapper.update: UPDATE exam_attempts SET entry_method = 'MANUAL', status = 'GRADED', total_score = #{totalScore}, max_score = #{maxScore}, correct_count = #{correctCount}, total_question_count = #{totalQuestionCount}, primary_weak_tag = #{primaryWeakTag}, graded_at = NOW() WHERE attempt_id = #{attemptId} AND attempt_no = 1 AND attempt_type = 'EXAM'
mapper.insert:
INSERT INTO exam_answers ( attempt_id, question_id, student_answer, is_correct, earned_score, created_at ) VALUES
( #{attemptId}, #{ans.questionId}, #{ans.studentAnswer}, #{ans.isCorrect}, #{ans.earnedScore}, NOW() )
mapper.select: SELECT u.user_id AS studentId, u.name AS studentName, COALESCE(c.target_grade, '초등') AS schoolGrade, COALESCE(u.phone, '010-0000-0000') AS parentPhone, ea.total_score AS savedTotalScore, CASE WHEN ea.attempt_id IS NOT NULL THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END AS isGraded, ( SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(COALESCE(eans.student_answer, '') ORDER BY eq.question_number ASC SEPARATOR ' ') FROM exam_answers eans JOIN exam_questions eq ON eans.question_id = eq.question_id WHERE eans.attempt_id = ea.attempt_id ) AS savedAnswers, ( SELECT pr.teacher_comment FROM parent_reports pr JOIN exams comment_exam ON comment_exam.exam_id = #{examId} WHERE pr.student_id = u.user_id AND YEAR(pr.period_start) = YEAR(comment_exam.exam_date) AND MONTH(pr.period_start) = MONTH(comment_exam.exam_date) ORDER BY pr.created_at DESC, pr.report_id DESC LIMIT 1 ) AS teacherComment FROM class_students cs JOIN users u ON cs.student_id = u.user_id JOIN classes c ON cs.class_id = c.class_id LEFT JOIN exam_attempts ea ON ea.exam_id = #{examId} AND ea.student_id = u.user_id AND ea.attempt_no = 1 AND ea.attempt_type = 'EXAM' WHERE cs.class_id = #{classId} AND cs.status = 'ACTIVE' ORDER BY u.name ASC
mapper.update: UPDATE parent_reports SET teacher_comment = #{comment}, created_by = #{teacherId} WHERE report_id = ( SELECT report_id FROM ( SELECT pr.report_id FROM parent_reports pr JOIN exams e ON e.exam_id = #{examId} WHERE pr.student_id = #{studentId} AND YEAR(pr.period_start) = YEAR(e.exam_date) AND MONTH(pr.period_start) = MONTH(e.exam_date) ORDER BY pr.created_at DESC, pr.report_id DESC LIMIT 1 ) latest_report )
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO parent_reports ( student_id, created_by, period_start, period_end, access_token, monthly_exam_score, class_average_score, comprehension_level, word_exam_completion_rate, monthly_exam_completion_rate, books_read_count, overcome_wrong_count, top_weak_type_tag, radar_chart_data, teacher_comment, status, created_at ) SELECT #{studentId}, #{teacherId}, DATE_FORMAT(e.exam_date, '%Y-%m-01'), LAST_DAY(e.exam_date), UUID(), 0.0, 0.0, 'F', 0.0, 0.0, 0, 0, '분석 중', '{}', #{comment}, 'DRAFT', NOW() FROM exams e WHERE e.exam_id = #{examId}
mapper.select: SELECT COALESCE(ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN c.class_id = #{classId} THEN ea.total_score END), 1), 0) AS classAvg, COALESCE(ROUND(AVG(ea.total_score), 1), 0) AS totalAvg FROM exam_attempts ea LEFT JOIN class_students c ON ea.student_id = c.student_id WHERE ea.exam_id = #{examId} AND ea.status = 'GRADED'
